nonadjacent_counterexample.scope: General projected matroid data; no polynomial-ideal realization is claimed.

actual_ideal_flags.scope: Actual polynomial quotient actions and border identities, not arbitrary matroid data. Finite controls support the uniform socle and ideal-flag proofs; no unrestricted count follows.

uniform_results.adjacent_exposed_direction_spaces: Nested for every cost and every linear projection; inclusion reverses according as the last greedy rank increment is one or at least two.
uniform_results.elementary_quotient_exposed_direction_sp: Nested for every actual one-dimensional linear quotient. Only the cost layer where the removed line first enters the prefix span changes; single-component support refines that component, multiple-component support merges components.
uniform_results.elementary_quotient_child_ray_condition: A new child ray requires the removed line to have support in multiple connected components of the pivot cost minor; it is a necessary condition, not a count.
uniform_results.positive_three_coordinate_overlay: max(a,b)<=c<=4*(a+b)+2, including flat and tied profile configurations
uniform_results.new_ray_necessary_condition: A new rank-r interior ray absent at rank r-1 must have last-layer rank increment one.
uniform_results.threshold_scope: The exact last greedy cost is linear on this O(a+b) refinement. The inherited O(k^(23/8)*log(k+1)^(3/8)) coarse power also follows from the previous shadow theorem on a direct sum; it is not a new unrestricted exponent.
uniform_results.norm_quotient_gap_fan: For every full-rank lattice of index m in Z^3, its faithful gap fan is the common refinement of the group ideal and its all-fields length-(m-1) norm quotient.
uniform_results.corank_one_boundary: The earlier binomial-extension envelope theorem already excludes polynomial amplification in this whole family and directly bounds the faithful gap diagram.
uniform_results.tensor_priority_boundary: The Pascal basis recursion is an iterated pointed-uniform two-sum substitution. The general Tutte substitution is classical; the exact code-specific priority remains unassessed.
uniform_results.actual_kernel_socle_rule: After a rank-preserving field extension, every finite algebra has an ideal composition series. A positive-filter initial kernel line is socle; each ordered child deletes the leading supported monomial of the parent kernel normal form, necessarily a staircase corner.
uniform_results.unbounded_merger_arity: A single socle relation in the degree-L simplex merges binom(L+2,2) singleton components at equal weight. The child still has exactly three initial ideals over every field.
uniform_results.actual_nonadjacent_crossing: The explicit all-fields chain of lengths 14,13,12 has face dimensions 1,2,1 at weight (1,1,1), with nonparallel outside edges. Its outside fan overlay has a new interior vertex and nine cells; adjacent nesting does not iterate.
uniform_results.local_realization_boundary: Arbitrary nested relation spaces on a downset maximal-corner support give actual ideal flags. They are already within the full-socle O(n^(3/2)) count, so a new global argument needs a length or multiplication-layer incidence budget.
uniform_results.unrestricted_incidence_obligation: A cubic polylogarithmic bound for U=sum_w ceil(sqrt(height(w)))*incident_cells(w) would give G3=O(n^(33/13)*log(n+1)^((10*C+3)/13)). This budget is unproved. The general conditional reduction is established; no unrestricted improvement follows yet.

scope: Exact finite controls for the uniform proofs. Exhaustive small projected faces and complete positive fans, actual integral group/norm quotients, shortest-path gap checks, uniform-gadget basis bijections and actual socle ideal flags. The new matrix-action and border checks independently verify nonadjacent crossings, unbounded merger arity and separator deletions. No growth fitting, generic-rank replacement, runtime benchmark or priority conclusion.
